name: Covington Plastic Molding
old_description: Covington Plastic Molding specializes in custom plastic injection molding solutions designed to meet the highest standards of precision and performance. With decades of hands-on manufacturing experience, our team delivers reliable, high-quality molded components for a wide range of industries.
about:
Covington Plastic Molding was founded in 1998 by brothers Scott and James Covington along with their father Steve in New Oxford, Pennsylvania. The family-owned business began with a focus on custom plastic injection molding and has since expanded to a second high-production facility in York, PA (added in 2019) and a warehousing operation (2023). Steve Covington brought 24 years of experience from a power-tool manufacturer, where he co-designed an early automatic mold-changing system.

The company operates as a complete in-house injection molding facility, offering mold design, tooling, and value-added secondary operations. Its capabilities span custom injection molding, CNC machining, wire EDM, stereolithography prototyping, and secondary processes such as ultrasonic welding, pad printing, heat staking, drilling, tapping, and milling. The New Oxford plant handles small to medium runs (1–25,000+ pieces) and quick-change mold work, while the York facility accommodates high-volume orders of 500,000+ parts. Materials range from commodity resins to engineering-grade polymers.

Covington serves a diverse industrial base including medical, electronics/electrical, communications, sporting goods, military, power tools, automotive, lighting, consumer products, and packaging. Examples from its case studies include automotive interior and under-hood components, medical device parts with tight tolerances, durable industrial equipment parts, consumer product components, and electronic enclosures.

The company emphasizes its collaborative approach, citing clear communication and responsive support from concept through production, along with strict quality control processes to meet exact specifications. Its founding was driven by the Covington family’s deep technical expertise in resin processing and mold technology, aiming to provide reliable, custom molding solutions with dependable turnaround times.
